issues.problem: nt-n4-a explain: said 貨 differs from 貸 only by lacking the dot stroke of 代; in fact the top is 化 (亻+匕) instead of 代 (亻+弋).
issues.action: Rewrote the sentence to contrast 化 (亻 + 匕) with 代 (亻 + 弋).

issues.problem: nt-n3-a explain: claimed 責 'has no radical at all'; its radical is 貝.
issues.action: Changed to '責 is the bare base with nothing on the left'.

issues.problem: nt-n3-a example 会議に適当な部屋: 適当 commonly reads as 'sloppy, any old', so 'suitable' is ambiguous for learners.
issues.action: Replaced with 適切な言葉を選んでください。 / 'Please choose appropriate words.'
